name: Nonna
bio: Waiting for you to make her kitchen in Pinch & Place. Everything she owns is made of plasticine.

portrait.subject: a cute claymation-style Italian grandmother with a grey bun, a polka-dot apron, a wooden spoon and a big warm smile, made of plasticine
portrait.background: claymation diorama kitchen with pastel walls

request: Ciao, bella! Nonna, from Pinch & Place! You make my kitchen beautiful, yes? And friends! 🍝
hello: Bellissimo! Come, I make you clay pasta!
A kitchen needs a big table and a warm lamp!
about: I'm Nonna! Everyone in the house has a room for you to make. Mine is the kitchen. Pinch me a stove, a table and lots of pots!
how: Pinch furniture, toys, rugs, lamps and pictures out of plasticine at the Clay Bench, then place them in the cut-away rooms to match each brief.
tips: Read each person's brief: needs first, wishes after!
Rugs go under furniture. Lamps up on tables.
Warm lamps make a room cosy.
chat: Pip's room has a little clay dinosaur. Cute!
Mr. Biscuit wants a bigger armchair. He always wants bigger.
I squished my spoon by accident. I made a new one!
The twins' playroom is chaos. Clay chaos.
nudge: Come, the Clay Bench is warm! 🍝
My kitchen needs a nice clock, bella!
idle: I cooked clay pasta for {ago}. It's cold now!

questions.q: What colour should my kitchen walls be?

update: Ciao! Pinch & Place is now v{version}! New clay!
